notes.title: Patch 2.1.2a
notes.content:
A patch to fix a few bugs. Check it out:

[list]
[*] There are a few scenes in which some tracks overlapped. Now, they have been fixed.
[*] A bug in which Fernando's scene (the image, literally speaking) freezes has been fixed.
[*] The main game now needs 1400 MB (or 1.4GB) of disk space.
[*] The DLC now needs 230 MB of disk space.

notes.title: Patch 2.1.0a
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A few Steam players [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1468430/discussions/0/2989791584239132058/]reported[/url] to me that the gallery wasn't working properly - some scenes were still blocked even when you had completed the whole game. So, [b]I fixed it by making two different galleries (SFW and NSFW)[/b]. The NSFW gallery has only the sexual scenes in the same order as the SFW gallery (Anderson's first and then Fernando's). Check it out:

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34679897/20106580a4a4fec36db4c8e79c908da47b3f0c4a.png[/img]
Also, [b]now at the beginning of the NSFW build you'll be able to choose if you want to play a NSFW or a SFW run. This means people who download the NSFW build can still play the SFW without having to download a new one.[/b]

Thank you all for your reports and for your patience.

Victoria Invicta

notes.title: A demo is coming - Join the Closed Test!
notes.content:
Hello, guys.

After we started [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468430/Freezer_Pops]Freezer Pops[/url], a lot of good things happened. We’ve reached more than 6 thousand downloads on Itch.io and every day the game is being more wishlisted on Steam (if you haven’t wishlisted it, please, do so - it helps us a lot to reach more players). Also, since we've developed many things and we are preparing a demo for you all, we would like to invite a few people for our closed test. But first, check what you'll find soon!

Anderson and Fernando, both datable guys, will be available on the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39256937/dc80fd4e60ad6b0bbbfab00be9f283a4c5669b66.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39256937/b0f84af5cb223b103bcb5528b216157eed6559b3.png[/img]

Maria Luiza, Alexandre’s competitor, will be introduced too. It’s time for you to meet the character that will complicate Alexandre’s plan to earn the money to pay for his rent! The name is written on her cooler sport (“Geladinho da Tia”) means Auntie’s Freezer Pops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39256937/2a4ebbced3e4dfc589612fcda2725cff8ae237e0.png[/img]

Laura, Alexandre’s neighbor from the 4th floor, will be introduced too. She will have a significant moment in the narrative and she brings more diversity to the cast. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39256937/580be25c67bdda88a768a03534b64c90774bdf1c.png[/img]

We've finished different romantic scenes for the guys. For Anderson, you’ll have a romantic dinner on a Brazilian barbecue, and for Fernando a fun night playing video game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39256937/b212e22d553bcf5055b18069416caea0937822ee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39256937/96281557e671ac0e3fc7a8e211e031b619b2003f.png[/img]

[b]Some important news:[/b] the narrative is already set up for both datable routes and the special ending. Victoria is already writing Anderson’s route and we have a new scriptwriter on the team who is already writing Fernando’s! We believe we’ll finish a route soon, but the arts for the complete game will take a few months since we have only one artist dedicated to draw every single scene!

Last but not least, this new build will be public released in June, but we’ve started a raffle on [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] so that people can send us feedback about it as well as help us to remove typos. 4 spots are available, so if you want to give it a shot, join [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] now. This raffle ends on May 25th.

Don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/maledoll]Steam page[/url] to get the latest news!

Male Doll Team
